t: Split Strings by Separator — Split and Filter
o: Purely mechanical: split each word on the separator character and collect non-empty pieces in order. Example 3 shows "|||" producing only empties, so the result is []. Constraints are tiny (100 strings × 20 chars), so any direct implementation works.
k: Language built-in split plus an empty-string filter solves it directly.

a.i: Use each language's split on a single character, filter out empty strings, flatten.
s: For each word, split on separator.

w: Watch regex metacharacters: separators like '.' or '$' must be escaped in Java's regex split (hence \\Q…\\E or backslash) and are fine in JS/Python when splitting on a plain string. C++ has no built-in split, so hand-roll the scan.
